name: Wynn Resorts
description: Wynn Resorts designs, develops and operates luxury integrated resorts, reporting four segments: Wynn Palace (Cotai, Macau), Wynn Macau (Macau Peninsula), Las Vegas Operations (Wynn Las Vegas/Encore), and Encore Boston Harbor (Massachusetts). Revenue is earned from casino gaming (table games and slots, with a heavy premium/VIP mix in Macau), hotel rooms, food & beverage, retail and entertainment. The company also holds a 40% minority equity interest in Wynn Al Marjan Island, a resort under development in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, expected to open in 2027 — this is a development-stage equity investment, not yet a reported operating segment.

founded.value: 2002 (by Stephen A. Wynn, Elaine P. Wynn and Kazuo Okada)

businessLines.name: Las Vegas Operations (Wynn Las Vegas & Encore)
businessLines.description: Single Las Vegas Strip integrated resort combining Wynn and Encore towers, casino, luxury retail (Wynn Plaza), nightlife/entertainment venues and convention space.

revenue.note: Company-level revenue by category: Casino $4.4bn, Rooms(Occupancy) $1.1bn, F&B $1.0bn across all four segments combined; per-segment gaming/non-gaming split not itemized in sources reviewed for this pass

businessLines.revenueNote: Company-level revenue by category: Casino $4.4bn, Rooms(Occupancy) $1.1bn, F&B $1.0bn across all four segments combined; per-segment gaming/non-gaming split not itemized in sources reviewed for this pass

businessLines.name: Encore Boston Harbor
businessLines.description: Single integrated resort in Everett, Massachusetts, serving the greater Boston/New England regional gaming market.

businessLines.name: Wynn Macau (Macau Peninsula)

share.text: part of the combined ~29% of consolidated net revenue attributable to Macau

businessLines.description: Integrated resort on the Macau Peninsula combining casino, hotel and retail; skews toward VIP/premium table games relative to Cotai properties.
businessLines.revenueNote: Wynn Macau and Wynn Palace combined Macau segment revenue reported at $2.3bn for FY2025; individual property split not separated in sources reviewed

businessLines.revenueNote: See Wynn Macau line — combined Macau segment revenue was $2.3bn in FY2025 across both properties; casino volumes grew at Wynn Palace per management commentary
